# NotContent Training

> AI creative training for agency and brand teams, from NotContent. Sydney-founded. Working globally across Sydney, LA, NYC and Bangkok.

- [Programs](https://training.notcontent.ai/programs): all programs and prices
- [Audit Workshop](https://training.notcontent.ai/programs/foundations): half day
- [The Operating Model](https://training.notcontent.ai/programs/transformation): 8 weeks
